'''Drygulch Ravine''' is a location in [[Durotar]]. Apart from falling down into the ravine from above, the only entrance is from [[Razorwind Canyon]], through a small cave at {{coords|52.3|27.3|Durotar}}.

==History==
Three years after the [[Third War]] ended, [[thunder lizard]]s escaped from [[Thunder Ridge]] and endangered the ravine. A young orc messenger from Drygulch Ravine went to [[Orgrimmar]] and reported the news to Warchief [[Thrall]].<ref>''[[Cycle of Hatred]]'', chapter 7</ref> In addition to the orcs living here, there is also a river that feeds the ravine.<ref>''[[Cycle of Hatred]]'', chapter 8</ref>

The ravine is now home to the [[Dustwind]] [[Harpy|harpies]]. They have taken to banditry, stealing supplies from caravans and hoarding them on their high cliffs. Here the harpies nest, and the most powerful of them guard their eggs.
